LanguageData.Rukaya_DietMeatNutrition: Nutrition from meat and mixed meals: 60%
LanguageData.Rukaya_DietInfoDescription: Rukaya need regular vegetarian food. More than three days without it causes -3 mood; six days or longer causes -10. Eating vegetarian food resets this timer and grants +10 mood for one day, refreshing rather than stacking. Meat and meals containing meat provide 60% nutrition and do not satisfy this need. Milk, eggs and fungi count as vegetarian food. Drugs and hemogen do not satisfy this need.
LanguageData.Rukaya_DietNeedAtMinimum: Eat vegetarian food to satisfy this need.
